name: entropia-agent-check
description: Due diligence on an ERC-8004 agent before you pay it or call it: live services and their health, metadata completeness, onchain feedback count and score, wallet activity and flags.

chain.description: EVM chain id where the agent is registered. Default 8453 (Base).

agent_id.description: Token id of the agent in the ERC-8004 Identity Registry.

agent.description: Chain id, token id, name and active flag of the agent under review.

verdict.description: One word judgement: usable, caution or avoid.

score.description: Reputation score from 0 to 100, combining health, metadata, feedback and wallet activity.

services.description: Declared services with their health status and latency.

feedback.description: Onchain feedback count and average score.

flags.description: Reasons behind the verdict, one line each.
